chunks: For although I have not reached the age of those who preceded me, I have observed their deeds, pondered their affairs, and walked in their footsteps, until I became like one of them; indeed, by virtue of what reached me of their affairs, I have lived with the first of them until the last,

and I distinguished its pure part from its turbid, its benefit from its harm. I have selected for you the choicest of every matter, chosen for you its best, and kept away from you its unknown/obscure parts.

and I considered in your affairs what concerns a loving father, and I resolved upon your upbringing that it should be while you are advancing in age and new to the world, possessing a sound intention and a pure soul.

and that I should begin with teaching you the Book of Allah, Mighty and Majestic, and its interpretation, the laws of Islam and its rulings, its lawful and unlawful matters, and I shall not go beyond these for you to other things.

Then I feared lest what people differed in, from their passions and opinions, become confused for you as it had become confused for them. Therefore, determining that for you, despite my dislike of warning you, was more dear to me than you surrendering to a matter in which I do not feel safe for you from destruction.
and I hoped that Allah would grant you success therein for your guidance, and guide you to your purpose. So I have committed to you this will of mine.
ai.seo_question: What educational principles did Imam Ali emphasize for his son Hasan in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: Delivered during the pivotal post-Siffin period, this testament reflects Imam Ali’s strategic shift from military leadership to intellectual preservation, emphasizing the transmission of authentic knowledge to safeguard the Ahl al-Bayt from sectarian deviation. By prioritizing the Quran and its *ta'wil* (interpretation) alongside *shara'i* (jurisprudence), he establishes a foundational curriculum for Hasan that integrates spiritual purity with legal clarity, ensuring resilience against the *ahwa'* (personal desires) that fractured the Muslim community.

en.sayed-ali-raza: even though I have not reached the age which those before me have, yet I looked into their behaviour and thought over events of their lives. I walked among their ruins till I was as one of them. In fact, by virtue of those of their affairs that have become known to me it is as though I have lived with them from the first to the last.

I have therefore been able to discern the impure from the clean and the benefit from the harm. I have selected for you the choicest of those matters and collected for you their good points and have kept away from you their useless points.

Since I feel for your affairs as a loving father should feel and I aim at giving you training, I thought it should be at a time when you are advancing in age and new on the stage of the world, possessing upright intention and clean heart

and that I should begin with the teaching of the Book of Allāh, to Whom belongs Might and Majesty, and its interpretation, the laws of Islam and its commands, its lawful matters and unlawful matters and that I should not go beyond these for you.

Then I feared lest you should get confused as other people had been confused on account of their passions and (different) views. Therefore, in spite of my dislike for you being so warned, I thought it better for me to make this position strong rather than leave you in a position where I do not regard you safe from falling into destruction.
I hoped that Allāh would help you in your straightforwardness and guide you in your resoluteness. Consequently, I wrote this piece of my will for you.
